temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been keeping something from Christian and says he is in some trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from him, which makes him anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; his suspicion is confirmed: Jonathan was hiding something and admits he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan was indeed hiding something and has admitted he is in some trouble, though the details are still unknown.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious, suspicious, and then worried/concerned after the admission.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To uncover the truth and understand what trouble Jonathan is in.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated, does not want to drag Christian into it, but accepts that he could use support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan was hiding something and has admitted he is in some trouble, though details are unknown.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Jonathan confirms the trouble is serious enough to need help, and Christian can support him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in serious, complicated trouble and needs Christian's support/resources; they can face it together.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer help and support Jonathan, and to help him find a way out of the mess.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot be sure whether the trouble is illegal, admits he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but denies doing anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan's trouble may be related to some kind of criminal activity; Christian feels conflicted and concerned.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Jonathan's response adds nuance: he may be entangled with wrong people but denies committing an illegal act himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be involved with wrong people/criminal elements, but he likely did not commit an illegal act himself; the matter needs discreet investigation.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate the matter discreetly without alarming Jonathan and to ensure his safety.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed; someone is trying to set him up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be entangled with wrong people/criminal elements, though he denies doing anything illegal himself, and Christian is investigating discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; the investigation shifts his belief from possible criminal involvement to Jonathan being framed/innocent.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed by someone; Christian needs to gather evidence to prove Jonathan's innocence and clear his name.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear Jonathan's name by gathering evidence and proving his innocence.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian finds out that the real culprit is someone close to and trusted by both him and Jonathan; Jonathan warns him to be careful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed by an unknown person, and Christian is gathering evidence to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; the unknown culprit is identified as someone close to and trusted by both Christian and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The real culprit is someone close to and trusted by both of them; this betrayal must be confronted and brought to justice.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
